A Nostr app connection is only the start of deciding what that app can do.

Our Nostr WoT tutorial walks through three choices for ordinary signing rules: Allow, Deny and Ask. The companion guide explains global defaults, per-site overrides and how to review individual requests.

Removing an override can make a global Allow apply again. Resetting a rule deserves the same attention as adding one.

We made this walkthrough to help you inspect the permissions behind your connected apps. Which rules does your current site inherit, and which have you changed?

Connection consent, backend and relay authentication, and Lightning payment permissions have separate controls.
